meta.name: etetoolkit
meta.description: Analyze, manipulate, compare, annotate, and visualize phylogenetic or other hierarchical trees with ETE 4. Use for Newick/Nexus tree I/O, topology edits and pattern matching, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, gene-tree evolutionary events and reconciliation, NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, SmartView exploration, and publication rendering. Do not use it to infer trees from raw sequences; align sequences and infer a tree first.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析、比较与注释进化树
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果处理系统发育数据并需要比较树结构。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze, compare, and annotate phylogenetic trees.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with phylogenetic data and need to compare tree topologies.

howto.what: Claude 会调用 ETE 工具集来处理进化树类数据:读取/改写多种树文件格式,调整树结构(剪枝、改根等),计算树之间的差异,识别基因复制/分化事件,查询 NCBI 分类信息,并输出 PDF/SVG 等图片。
howto.when: 当用户要求对进化树文件(Newick 等)做修改、比较、可视化等处理时触发;不用于从序列推断树。

say.text: 请分析 tree.nw 的节点数和叶子数。
say.note: 会输出树的基本统计信息。

say.text: 计算这两棵树的 Robinson-Foulds 距离。
say.note: 会返回差异度量及共同叶子数。

say.text: 把 gene_tree.nw 渲染成 PDF 并标注支持率。

howto.what_en: Claude uses ETE to handle phylogenetic/hierarchical trees: I/O of Newick/NHX etc., topology edits, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, evolutionary event detection, NCBI taxonomy lookup, and PDF/SVG rendering.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user provides a tree file (e.g., Newick) and asks to modify, compare, or visualize it; not for inferring trees from raw sequences.

say_en.text: Analyze tree.nw and report leaf and node counts.
Compute the Robinson-Foulds distance between these two trees.
Render gene_tree.nw to PDF with support labels.
